svg.title: Approach to a sexual health concern: know your biases, ask permission and take the CDC 5 P's, then the Pleasure questions place the concern in a phase of the response cycle (desire, arousal, orgasm and resolution) or outside it (pain, illness, trauma); each column gives the question to ask, what is normal in both sexes, and how women and men differ
